ant_colony_walk.name: Two trails underfoot
ant_colony_walk.description: Walk among24 carried PointBody spheres. Searching reads food/leaves home; returning reverses channels. Hold to pause and move. Two control banks.
ant_colony_walk.qfep_connection: Different states read and sustain different shared traces. Replacement preserves inherited marks; clearing removes them. Brightness alone establishes no optimality.
